card.name: Numbers after journal names in citations
card.fires_on: The space or punctuation right after a journal name, or the first digit of a volume or year, in reference lists. It also fires on a digit or hyphen inside a number such as a date or mission code (STS-107).

modes.label: Journal volume number
modes.description: The space or first digit where a volume number follows a journal title in a citation.

modes.label: Year then volume
modes.description: The semicolon or first digit between the year and volume in a citation.

modes.label: Dates and mission codes
modes.description: The space or digit inside a date or shuttle mission number.
modes.example: Astronauts from STS-85 and STS<<->>87 host the show.

card.writes: It seems to push the next digits of a number, with no clear link to the listed tokens.
card.plain: It lights up where a volume or date number is about to start in a reference citation.
